title: Bryn Horton
description: Horton Voted in favor of a resolution that supports transgender students participating in athletics based on their gender identity/expression not biological sex.
body:
# Bryn Horton

# Board of Education Vice President

![](/media/uploads/2026/03/horton-profile.jpg)

- **[Voted in favor](https://resources.finalsite.net/images/v1594728898/sunprairiek12wius/w4umpvxb7qwzjya0xi9d/BoardResolutionLGBTQPrideMonth-FBandWebsite1_1.pdf)** of a resolution that supports transgender students participating in athletics based on their gender identity/expression not biological sex.
- **[Promoted a white guilt narrative](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/eea11e22-861b-4b89-a4a0-159a18098bc1/WI-Bryn-Horton-white-woman-post.png)** and committed to becoming more anti-racist herself as she called for the board to change its actions and policies to “be anti-racist and equity-focused.”

![](/media/uploads/2026/04/sunprairie-bryn.jpg)
